about.metaDescription: Learn about TWINCO Solution — our background, product capabilities, environmental approach, dealer partnerships and contact details.
about.heroDesc: Twinco is a Danish brand providing reliable professional workplace solutions for European businesses. Our products are developed around quality, function and durability, serving office, display, warehouse and ergonomic working environments.
about.introTitle: Twinco connects product development, manufacturing and European distribution.
about.cap1Text: Twinco supplies office and workplace solutions to European businesses, covering ergonomic footrests, the patented Elephant step stool, display systems, and office and computer accessories.
about.cap2Text: Backed by in-house manufacturing and a European distribution network, Twinco builds long-term partnerships on delivery reliability, consistent product quality and competitive pricing.
about.cap3Text: More than 500 active dealers and partners have chosen Twinco as a long-term supplier, reaching end customers through the dealer network.
about.sec1Title: A Danish Brand Serving European Customers
about.sec1Text: TWINCO Solution is a Danish company founded in 1975. Working with L2 Lager & Logistik for warehousing and logistics, we supply European customers from Denmark with products carrying a Scandinavian design sensibility. The company is deliberately lean and responsive, and our customers include leading businesses in the office and computer accessories sectors. Twinco also maintains a sales office and manufacturing operations in China.
about.sec2Title: High-Quality Accessories Developed for Professional Users
about.sec2Text: Twinco focuses on developing office and computer accessories for professional users, with an emphasis on delivering on time, as agreed and to specification. The website provides dimensional drawings, installation drawings and high-resolution product photography that dealers can use for technical verification, printed material or their own websites. Twinco supplies exclusively through dealers and remains flexible on quantity and pricing.
about.sec3Title: Reducing Environmental Impact Through Durable Design
about.sec3Text: Twinco takes environmental responsibility seriously in production. A long service life means products do not need frequent replacement; plastic materials can be granulated and recycled back into production, packaging carries recycling marks, and the steel and aluminium in our table products can be remelted and reused.
about.sec4Title: Growing Customer Relationships Together With Dealers
about.sec4Text: Through quality products with genuine function and design, Twinco helps dealers maintain and expand their customer relationships. Companies interested in working with us can get in touch via the contact form, email or telephone, and Twinco will work out a suitable trading arrangement based on the partner's business model.
contact.metaDescription: Send your name, email, subject and message through the Twinco contact form, and find TWINCO Solution's address, telephone number and opening hours.
contact.title: Contact Us
contact.desc: Once completed, the form can be sent to TWINCO Solution through your local email client. The fields match those on the original site's contact form.
